vision.one_line: A compact, offline, evidence-aware functional graph for bounded James Software agent context.
vision.north_star: A fresh clone lets an agent query useful public functional concepts without reproducing a third-party knowledge base or inventing internals.
vision.promise: Structured JSON, direct source pointers, deterministic checks, and explicit unknowns make the repository inspectable and useful without network access.

principles.title: Agent-first product surface
principles.rule: Make the graph, source pointers, schemas, query CLI, and checks primary; Markdown explains the boundaries.

principles.title: JSON-first artifacts
principles.rule: Use JSON for machine-consumable graph, selected-source, link-index, schema, and vision artifacts.

principles.title: Fail closed on evidence and public boundary
principles.rule: Unsupported implementation details remain unknown; payload-like content and local provenance fail validation or scanning.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Can an agent consume the graph without scraping prose?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Graph, source pointers, schemas, and query commands are structured and local.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Can a fresh clone validate and query it locally?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Standard-library checks and commands run without network access.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Does missing evidence fail closed?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Evidence types and unknowns are required; validator tests reject unsafe graph shape.

review_checklist: Does the change preserve a compact original graph rather than a source substitute?
Are fact, inference, and unknown boundaries preserved?
Are source pointers direct and minimal?
Has an independent reviewer approved the exact staged public tree before publication?

maturity_model.meaning: The structured graph and boundaries exist.
Validation, scan, and regression tests pass locally.
An independent reviewer approves the exact staged tree and source boundary before publication.

residual_risk_wording: Local checks prove repository shape and obvious boundary regressions; they do not certify rights clearance, product correctness, or publication authorization.
